title: KU Marching Jayhawks to represent university in London at Union Jack Classic
summary_en: Members of the University of Kansas Marching Jayhawks will travel to London this month to represent KU at the Union Jack Classic, where the band will perform at the KU football game against Arizona State University on Sept. 19 at Wembley Stadium.
title_cn: KU Marching Jayhawks to represent university in London at Union Jack Classic

title: Four KU seniors to compete for Rhodes, Marshall, Churchill scholarships
summary_en: Four University of Kansas seniors — Saad Awan, Kaitlyn Carson, Katherine Goodwin and Jaden Huehl — have been endorsed for prestigious fellowships for study in the United Kingdom with the support of KU’s Center for Undergraduate Research & Fellowships.
title_cn: Four KU seniors to compete for Rhodes, Marshall, Churchill scholarships

title: KU Engineering’s Tiberti Lecture returns this fall with a focus on managing difficult conversations
summary_en: Aaron Mann, senior principal and chief legal officer at Terracon, will deliver the J.A. Tiberti Family Lecture at the University of Kansas School of Engineering at 2:30 p.m. Oct. 15 in the Beren Auditorium.
title_cn: KU Engineering’s Tiberti Lecture returns this fall with a focus on managing difficult conversations
